title: Shared resource cache foundation on Companion
description: Use an isolated stack with source offline-proof backed by octocat/Spoon-Knife. A second real client pins test-branch and the open panel and shared controller must update through resource.changed.

proofTargets.claim: The native request adapter and shared cache consume stamped real reads and recover on same-epoch reconnect.
A source pin from a second client updates the open Sources panel without user action.

start.intent: Observe Sources through the shared cache over the app's existing authenticated socket.

main.intent: Set the isolated proof source to main through a real second client.

main-visible.intent: The actual settings panel renders the source's main selection.

details.intent: Open the actual source details before the external pin changes them.

pin.intent: Commit a pin from another authenticated client and await its stamped cache result.

pin-proof.intent: Require the real shared cache to cover the committed pin.

pin-visible.intent: The open Sources panel rereads after resource.changed without Refresh.

capture.intent: Record the visible result of the external mutation.

reconnect.intent: Reconnect the actual socket under the same gateway epoch and require another cache read.

reconnect-proof.intent: Require a new covered read after same-epoch reconnect.

stop.intent: Dispose the proof controller and its subscriptions.
